title: Shell options
head:
1
The app's shell: three ways the chat and the dashboard meet

MyPaisa as one iOS app (MA-161, MA-163). Every option has the same screens (the chat and its cards, Home, a holding, Audit, Activity, the Admin center, You); they differ in what the app opens to and how the chat and the figures meet. Warm ledger (MA-101) is the content; Liquid Glass is only the layer of controls above it: the tab bar, the sidebar, toolbar buttons, the composer and its shortcut chips. iPhone in light and dark, then iPad in landscape. The flow boards in this project are drawn in 1a's shell, which Arun picked on 26 Oct 2026; 1b and 1c stay as the record. Illustrative figures and names.

head:
W4
Web v4 · Dashboard: the household's whole wealth across the UK and India

The Overview of MyPaisa v4 in a browser (MA-186): net worth in pounds or rupees, what we own and owe, each country and each member, liquid and locked, and what is due. One markup on the design system's adaptive shell, drawn at desktop 1440 (sidebar, the page, and the chat beside it) and at 390 (the phone-web door: one column, the chat is a tab). Anything new is made in the chat (a card, Confirm, the audit row); an existing figure is corrected in place. Every figure is the engine's, from the household figure set: today is Mon 26 Oct 2026, prices are at the Fri 23 Oct close, and £1 = ₹112.50 (ECB). Illustrative figure

MA-103. Arun asked for a motion-animated brand. Three different ideas, each drawn by hand on a 48 grid in DS v1 Warm ledger: the hero navy (#13213A, #1A2944 on dark), coral (#FF6B4F, #FF7A5E on dark), ink, white and the warm ground #F6F4F1, with the hero card's own inner tones where a coin sits on navy. Arun asked for a new design system after the Monzo app and Apple's Human Interface Guidelines, for the iOS app and the web app (MA-101). Each direction is shown on the Overview at phone width (light, dark) and in the browser (light, dark), and on one in-app chat card. Figures, members and holdings are illustrative. MyPaisa DS v1 · iOS kit

The native app for iPhone and iPad (MA-161) in Warm ledger. The content stays solid (the navy hero, cards, lists, charts, messages) and Liquid Glass is only the layer of controls that floats above it, as Apple's HIG for iOS 26 says. Every class here is in tokens.css and ios.css; each board shows light and dark, and the screens built from them are in the MyPaisa iOS v1 project. Illustrative figures and names.
